notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ⑧ - Boss Battles
notes.content:
●Shoot 'em Up Part

- Boss Battles
Face the Executioners in intense boss battles.
Smash through "Mind Walls" and "Brain Barriers"—the shields that manifest to protect the Executioners' innermost thoughts—and prove that you've been falsely accused! 

[previewyoutube=_73zybAIxfY;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ⑦ - Mind Maze
notes.content:
●Shoot 'em Up Part

- Mind Maze
The neuron pathway is a visualization of the route leading to the core of the Executioner's brain, containing what they perceive as the truth. Complete the sentences relating to each incident and clear a way through the labyrinth of thoughts.

[previewyoutube=dlW3tht4jpI;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ⑥ - Prejudice Synapse
notes.content:
●Shoot 'em Up Part

- Prejudice Synapse
Explore a visual representation of your Executioner's mind. 

Use the evidence you acquire during the adventure sections to destroy the prejudices lurking in their heads, and free them from the notion that you, the Prisoner, are guilty.

[previewyoutube=FecMHZpJKfc;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ⑤ - Shoot ‘em Up Stages
notes.content:
●Shoot 'em Up Part

- Shoot 'em Up Stages
As a Prisoner, you'll be hunted down by a whole host of different foes.
Defeat your assailants, and avoid being gunned down as you try and get through to your Executioner!

[previewyoutube=mWmH5eEG2a0;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ④ - High-speed Quiz
notes.content:
●Shoot 'em Up Part

- High-speed Quiz
Take to the helm of your Yurukill Fighter and delve into the details of your alleged crimes in high-speed quizzes.

Gain lives for use in the BR (Brain Reality) depending on how many answers you get right.

[previewyoutube=BrcyR9illVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ③ - Yurukill Judgement
notes.content:
●Shoot 'Em Up Part

- Yurukill Judgement
Experience the cutting-edge BR (Brain Reality), developed by Yurukill, Inc.
Prisoners and Executioners pilot Yurukill Fighters within the virtual reality generated by the BR. Prisoners must stake their lives on these nail-biting firefights as they seek the truth behind the incidents they stand accused of!

Difficulty can be adjusted for players wishing to focus on the story.

[previewyoutube=lIeItK7kFqo;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Update: 06/27/2022
notes.content:
Hello,

We are aware that some users are experiencing an issue in which the demo won’t start. To help us investigate and try and reproduce the issue, if we could trouble you to let us know the following details when posting a comment/feedback, that would be highly appreciated!
This also applies to other bug reports in general!

- OS version
- The timing at which you encountered the issue
- Graphics card
- Processor
- RAM

Thank you.

-IzanagiGames

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ② - Maji-Kill Time
notes.content:
●Adventure Part

- Maji-Kill Time
Lay it all on the line in extreme, life or death cross-examinations!

Executioners can end the life of their Prisoners any time via their Yurukill Passports. With their lives hanging in the balance, Prisoners must face cross-examination at the hands of their Executioners.

Make the correct selections and make it through the trials in one piece!

[previewyoutube=qFOP9N5uLho;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.

notes.title: Yurukill: The Calumniation Games Gameplay Showcase ① - Puzzle Solving
notes.content:
●Adventure Part

- Puzzle Solvinfg
Investigate attractions and uncover clues to help solve the puzzles you encounter. 

With their sights set on victory, the teams face their attractions in the Yurukill Games. The items you acquire by solving puzzles are the key to unlocking the secrets behind everything.

Glean hints from helpful conversations there to support the player and ensure even the toughest riddles aren't an obstacle to enjoying the game.

[previewyoutube=1lVl3s4npBQ;full][/previewyoutube]

*Footage is from a development build.
